page_title: LAZ 1-1 COM | Lazio v Como 10/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Lazio earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
86' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Paride Tremolada saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Como.
85' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) in, Patrick Cutrone out.
85' Here is a change. Gabriel Strefezza is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Ben Lhassine Kone (Como).
84' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) has received a yellow card for his foul.

81' That was close by Gabriel Strefezza (Como)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
80' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
73' That's the end of the game for Gustav Isaksen, who is replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).

72' 1 - 1 Gabriel Strefezza sends a superb cross into the box. Patrick Cutrone (Como) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the top left corner, leaving Ivan Provedel beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
71' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

70' A pass travels right across the box to Alieu Fadera (Como) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the left post, but Ivan Provedel denies him with a decent save. The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
70' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
69' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Alberto Moreno is replaced by Andrea Belotti (Como).
66' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is able to continue to play.
65' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Assane Diao (Como) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) was quite harsh and Paride Tremolada didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nuno Tavares (Lazio) replacing Luca Pellegrini.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Lazzari trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adam Marusic (Lazio).
58' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) receives a yellow card! It's his second one today, which means he will be send off!
57' Paride Tremolada shows a yellow card to Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
56' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Paride Tremolada signals a set piece. Como are awarded a free kick.
51' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Como have been awarded a free kick.

50' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paride Tremolada blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lazio, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
49' A quickly taken corner by Como.
49' Alberto Dossena (Como) meets a cross and produces a header towards the top right corner, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
48' The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.

48' Patrick Cutrone (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

47' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
47' Como force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Alberto Moreno (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
39' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
38' Como couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
37' Paride Tremolada couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Como in a dangerous position.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Matteo Guendouzi manages to prod the ball to Boulaye Dia (Lazio) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
31' Unlucky! Patrick Cutrone (Como) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
28' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paride Tremolada had an easy-decision to make. Como are awarded a free kick from long range.
26' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but Jean Butez punches the ball away.
25' A clumsy foul by Assane Diao (Como) and Paride Tremolada blows his whistle. Lazio win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
25' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Jean Butez (Como) leaps to collect the ball.

24' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Nico Paz is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Assane Diao (Como).
18' The linesman signals that Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
18' The resulting corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Nico Paz (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
16' Nico Paz (Como) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Como.
16' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
14' The referee blows his whistle as Alieu Fadera (Como) was too aggressive in his challenge. That's a free kick to Lazio.
13' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) commits a rough foul. Paride Tremolada stops the game and makes a call. Lazio are awarded the free kick.
11' Rough tackle by Boulaye Dia (Lazio). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Como have a free kick.

10' Fine attempt! Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
10' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' The corner is flicked onto Nico Paz (Como), but his close-range header flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
9' Como earn a corner.
6' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle as Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Lazio are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
5' A long-range free kick is awarded to Como.
4' Nico Paz (Como) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Paride Tremolada got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
